vision: A 9-stage pipeline that pre-analyzes ITSM change requests for CAB meetings, working with real-world incomplete data from day one. Treats missing artifacts as findings, not errors. Validates against BPI Challenge 2014 real ITIL change records from Rabobank.
direction: Python 3.12+, Pydantic v2, sequential pipeline with disk checkpoints. Real-first data strategy: BPI 2014 as primary dataset, synthetic fixtures as regression tests. MVP stages at L1 baseline + L2 ML for stages 8 (embedding similarity) and 9 (LLM narrative). Graceful degradation: stages 4/5/7 skip when artifacts missing. Output: JSON + Markdown report.

trade_offs.decision: Real-first with BPI 2014 instead of synthetic-first
trade_offs.reasoning: Real data grounds the pipeline in actual ITSM patterns. Synthetic data follows ITIL templates by construction and is too clean. Starting with real data forces graceful degradation from day one.

trade_offs.decision: Pipeline accepts partial CR bundles (only itsm_record required)
trade_offs.alternative: Require all 7 mandatory artifacts as originally designed
trade_offs.reasoning: Real-world CRs are incomplete. No public dataset has runbooks or rollback plans. Enterprise data is also often incomplete. Partial acceptance is both realistic and necessary for real-data validation.

trade_offs.decision: Spike on BPI 2014 before finalizing schema changes
trade_offs.alternative: Finalize schemas first based on ARCHITECTURE.md design
trade_offs.reasoning: Schema changes depend on understanding what fields actually exist in the real data. Designing schemas before exploring data risks rework.

trade_offs.decision: MVP includes L2 ML for stages 8 (embedding) and 9 (LLM), not L1-only
trade_offs.alternative: All stages at L1 script-only for MVP
trade_offs.reasoning: L1-only MVP validates architecture but not the ML thesis. Stage 8 L2 (embedding similarity) has real GT from BPI 2014 (56 tuples) enabling measurable L1-vs-L2 comparison. Stage 9 L2 (LLM narrative) validates end-to-end LLM integration within cost ceiling. Stages 4/5/7 have no real data for ML validation.

L2 catches semantically similar but differently categorized patterns (e.g. 'config change' vs 'configuration update')
Similarity threshold tunable via config (default 0.75, range 0.5-0.95)
Graceful fallback: if sentence-transformers not installed (no 'ml' extras), falls back to L1 only with warning log
pytest tests: synthetic case where L1 misses and L2 catches (different category names, same semantic meaning)
Benchmark test: measure L1 vs L2 recall/precision on BPI 2014 56 GT tuples, output comparison table
